text.tspan: Connecting Agents to GitHub with MCP
One server, two ways to run it: remote (nothing to install) or local; scope it with toolsets and read-only mode
remote with a PAT header, or local
auth: OAuth or a PAT header
The server acts as you: your org and
repository permissions and the token or
OAuth scopes still apply. Prefer read-only
